title: Enterprise Architecture (EA) Tool Licensing, Maintenance, and Support
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE INFORMATION SYSTEMS AGENCY (DISA).IT CONTRACTING DIVISION - PL84
description_text: The Defense Commissary Agency (DeCA) requires licensing, maintenance, and support services for the Avolution ABACUS Enterprise Architecture (EA) tool to effectively manage its business, information, and technology architectures. This provides DeCA with a digital planning and analytics tool that allows its leadership to make more informed decisions on how to optimize resources, improve operations, and comply with Department of Defense regulations. Essentially, this tool helps DeCA ensure that its 238 commissaries worldwide are run efficiently, using up-to-date information to plan improvements, reduce risks, and maintain compliance with necessary standards. Please see the attached solicitation for additional information
